title: Ambiguous retries and duplicate effects
method: Synthetic 100 intended operations plus 20 retries after post-commit timeouts. Attempts=100+20. Naive execution creates 120 effects; atomic idempotency creates100. Assumes durable keys and identical retry payloads; not an observed failure rate.
alt: Ambiguous retries and duplicate effects. Execution attempts: 120 operations, Naive effects: 120 operations, Idempotent effects: 100 operations. Illustrative data.
